description: This file is a shell script containing test procedures for the git-cvsserver project. It sets up repositories, runs various CVS and git commands, and checks behaviors related to file attributes, binary/text detection, and inline file content verification across different test scenarios.

methods.name: marked_as
methods.description: Checks if a specific file in a directory has the expected CVS Entries mark or binary mode (via -kb).

methods.name: not_present
methods.description: Verifies that a file is not present or is not readable in a directory, confirming deletion or absence.

methods.name: check_status_options
methods.description: Performs 'cvs status' on a file and verifies the sticky options (like -kb).
